text:
kevin_infra: Observed short CE spike across ~7 A100 cards in us-west-2 pool-c. lasted ~9m, peaks ~120-130 CE/min on two GPUs. no Xid seen so far.

maria_ops: Are they concentrated on one host or spread? rack?

kevin_infra: Spread over 3 hosts in the same rack. one host shows nvlink_retransmits uptick.

alex_sre: Any user-facing impact (5xx/latency)?

kevin_infra: No 5xx. minor p95 latency bump (~15ms) on a couple routes. overall SLOs unchanged.

sasha_ml: Any thermal/power events in ops?

kevin_infra: Checked chillers and power rails, nothing flagged.

jitendra_platform: Which PromQL did you use? want to tune alert windows.

kevin_infra: PromQL I ran: 
```
sum(rate(gpu_correctable_ecc_total{region=\"us-west-2\",model=\"A100\"}[1m])) by (gpu_uuid)
```
aggregated up to host for alerts.

maria_ops: Proposal for automated policy (editable params):
- transient_window = 12m (ignore unless recurring)
- persistent_window = 12-45m -> soft-drain
- hard_window = >45m OR any Xid -> hard-drain
- soft_ce_threshold = 60/min
- hard_ce_threshold = 150/min

alex_sre: Suggest a composite score instead of single-thresholding to reduce FP:
score = 0.5 * sigmoid(ce_rate/200) + 0.3 * min(nvlink_retransmits/100, 1) + 0.2 * has_xid
evict if score > 0.65 for persistent_window.

jitendra_platform: Add region capacity guard: block soft-drain if region_spare < 7% (unless Xid). also set per-host cooldown = 3h to avoid cascade replacements.

maria_ops: Ops runbook additions:
- Step 1: mark GPUs NO_NEW_ALLOCS for 15m and notify oncall.
- Step 2: run `nvdiag --quick` and collect dmesg + driver logs + ECC dumps. attach to incident.
- Step 3: if nvdiag fails or Xid present -> schedule hard-evict + replacement.
- Step 4: if diag clean but bursts repeat within 24h -> rotate card.

sasha_ml: For Dedicated tenants, add routing fallback to warm-standby nodes (pre-warmed model containers) when soft-drain occurs to preserve SLAs.

kevin_infra: Can we also include pci_tx_errors and temperature trends into signal set? some flakes correlated with small temp oscillations.

jitendra_platform: yes. plan: combine CE, nvlink_retransmits, pci_errors, temp_delta, and Xid into score. controller will expose flags and thresholds via configmap and support dry-run.

alex_sre: Add telemetry `auto_evict_decision{reason=\"transient|soft|hard\"}` for auditing and false-positive analysis. Also emit `evict_candidate_score` per-gpu.

maria_ops: Ops oncall: watch these hosts for 2h, escalate to infra leads if Xid appears or hard-evict triggers.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-4021 (ECC burst us-west-2) with runbook link and attached GPU list.

jitendra_platform: I'll open a PR for the controller that implements the three-tier flow + score. will include a dry-run mode for 72h which simulates decisions and writes audit metrics but does not evict.

maria_ops: I'll draft an RFC with the thresholds, PromQL examples, and runbook edits. initial rollout: enable dry-run across non-prod pools, then enable soft-drain for non-critical pools. hard-drain remains manual by default.

alex_sre: Note replacement lead time estimate ~4 business days. document shipping + spares inventory in RFC.

kevin_infra: Dropping logs and GPU UUID list: s3://redwood-ops/tmp/ecc-pool-c-1934567890.tar.gz

sasha_ml: Agreed to staged rollout. after 72h dry-run, we'll review decisions and adjust score weights.

maria_ops: Thanks team. expected PR by EOD tomorrow.

kevin_infra: Closing loop: we'll keep soft-drain automated for pools with >10% spare capacity after the initial dry-run evaluation.
